ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the diagram below, which organism will be most directly affected by a decrease in the amount of corn?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food/production flowchart. At the top, “Sunlight” points with arrows respectively to “Maize plant” on the left and “Wheat plant” on the right. In the left branch, “Maize plant” points downward to “Corn for feeding chicken”, below which is a chicken labeled “Chicken”. In the right branch, “Wheat plant” points downward to text explaining that wheat grains are ground into wheat flour; the diagram also shows an arrow from “Chicken meat used in making” pointing to the pizza labeled “Chicken pizza”. Reasoning: The question asks which organism will be affected most directly when the amount of corn decreases. In the diagram, corn is clearly a food source for “feeding chicken” and directly supplies chickens. Therefore, a decrease in corn will most directly affect chickens.
